Dear Atlas Mutual team,

I read that Atlas Mutual launched online claim tracking for members this year. Claims that members can follow online are the kind of feature I would like to work on.

I am a junior software engineer at Tessellate Labs with two years of experience in TypeScript, Node.js and PostgreSQL. I built the React admin screens for refunds and credit notes and maintain the invoicing service.

Could we set up a short call?

Best regards,
Rania Haroon
